headline_cluster.headline: פי 76 מהיעד המומלץ: זה הרכב שכבש את ראש טבלת הקרינה - מדידות הקרינה ברכבים עודכנו

claims.claim_he_or_en: BYD Sealion 5 פלאג-אין: 304 מיליגאוס, מקום ראשון במאגר
claims.verified_figure: BYD Sealion 5, PHEV, 304 mG; row 1 of 79 (highest value in table)

claims.note: Exact match. Consistent with July 2026 coverage where Jaecoo 7 (~280) was the top value, so "overtaken" framing holds.
Exact match (the Ministry sheet itself spells it Link&Co; brand is Lynk & Co). Claim that 2 of 7 new models entered the top five also holds (#1 and #3).

claims.claim_he_or_en: ועדת המומחים ממליצה על יעד לחשיפה כרונית של עד 4 מיליגאוס; המלצה, לא תקן מחייב
claims.verified_figure: 4 mG precautionary chronic-exposure target (secondary corroboration only)
claims.note: Ministry guidance page was unreachable (403), so this is SECONDARY corroboration: multiple outlets covering earlier Ministry updates cite the same 4 mG committee target and "not a binding standard" wording, and the July update used a /4 multiplier (210 mG = x52.5). Secondary sources indicate the target is a time-averaged (daily) chronic value; the PR release describes the committee classifying vehicles by AVERAGE exposure above 4 mG assuming ~18 h driving/week. Not confirmed against primary text.

claims.claim_he_or_en: Sealion 5 גבוה פי 76 מהיעד המומלץ (כותרת: "פי 76 מהיעד המומלץ")
claims.note: Arithmetic correct and matches the /4 convention seen in prior Ministry-linked multipliers. However the XLSX states the value is the maximum at a single point in the cabin, while the 4 mG target is a chronic, time-averaged exposure target. The headline juxtaposes the two without that context (the body partly supplies it: "המלצה לחשיפה ממושכת", "ערך החשיפה המרבי"). Ministry's own stated multiplier for Sealion 5 not found (guidance page unreachable).
"Almost 68x" is a fair rounding. Same caveat as e: point maximum vs. time-averaged chronic target.

claims.claim_he_or_en: קיה ספורטאז' היברידי: 99 מיליגאוס, כמעט פי 25 מהיעד
claims.note: Exact match; same point-max vs chronic-target caveat as e.

claims.claim_he_or_en: המדידות לפי התקן הבינלאומי IEC 62764, במספר נקודות ישיבה; הנתון המתפרסם הוא הערך המרבי
claims.verified_figure: XLSX header: per 'התקן האירופי IEC 62764'; values = maximum measured in each vehicle (at a specific point); measured by SafeFields with a Ministry-licensed permit holder
claims.note: Standard and max-value convention confirmed. Ministry calls it "European standard" (IEC is international; immaterial). Article omits that the measurements were performed by a private company (SafeFields), not the Ministry itself. "Multiple seating positions" is not stated in the XLSX; corroborated only by secondary coverage.

claims.claim_he_or_en: BYD Atto 2: 8; Citroën Berlingo: 2; Citroën C5 Aircross: 1.6; Changan Deepal S07: 0 מיליגאוס
claims.verified_figure: BYD Atto2 BEV 8; Citroen Berlingo BEV 2; Citroen C5 Aircross ICE 1.6; Changan Deepal S07 BEV 0
claims.note: All four values and drivetrains match. The XLSX does not mark which models are new in this update; the "seven new models" count is not verifiable from the sheet alone. Note the sheet's last-update date is 15.9.2026, ~6 weeks before the article, so the "update" is not brand-new.

primary_source_urls: https://www.gov.il/he/pages/radiation_of_electrical_frequency?chapterIndex=2 (Ministry guidance page; HTTP 403 from this environment, not read)
primary_source_note: Ministry XLSX downloaded and parsed directly (79 rows, 'תאריך עדכון אחרון: 15.9.2026', file modified 2026-09-15). Sheet header: measurements performed by private company SafeFields per 'התקן האירופי IEC 62764', accompanied by a Ministry-licensed radiation-measurement permit holder; values are the maximum field measured in each vehicle at a specific point. The gov.il guidance page with the expert-committee wording returned 403, so claim d rests on secondary corroboration.
